en: A black-and-white photograph depicting a European street scene from the early 20th century. The street is lined with multi-story brick buildings with sloped roofs typical of Northern or Central Europe. There are people walking and riding bicycles, and a horse-drawn cart is visible. The signage on the corner building reads 'Handel', suggesting a commercial establishment.
